name: 2D Calculator
summary:
With this calculator you can do basic calculations and you will have more future features to make it more productive.

How to use:
1 - Enter the First Number: Start by typing the first number.
2 - Choose an Operator: Select the mathematical operator for the calculation:
+ for addition.
- for subtraction.
* for multiplication.
/ for division.
% for percentage.
3 - Enter the Second Number: Type the second number to complete the operation.
4 - Press the Equals (=) Button: View the result of your calculation.
